These minimized fixtures preserve the actual schemas, field names, and
authenticated hashes from Panel A event `k02_s1` in the committed
`evidence_bundle.tar.gz` at commit `2683c775c2ba29018404c5f41ca2aff3266b5739`.

The witness intentionally omits the finite-CG journal hash. It is a physical
integer witness for the named event representation, not a claim that its
routes are contained in the finite CG pool used by `fleet_phase2.json`.
